name: recommended-2025-26
description: Separate volume accumulation and team-success bonuses from genuine individual actions, then put each position back on an equal footing. Ball recoveries, duels won, accurate passes, long balls, and defender clearances and aerials are cut because they pay for minutes more than skill. Clean sheets, corners conceded and high claims are cut because they track how good the player's team is — a centre back at a top side racks them up without doing more than one at a relegation candidate. Tackles won, interceptions, blocks, clearances off the line, saves and key passes are raised instead so value follows what a manager can actually scout. Crosses, corners forced and dribbles are raised for creators. Forward goals, shots and assists are lifted so strikers outside the top clubs stay viable. Position scalars then restore each position's share of the elite tier without using team-result categories as the lever.
